Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 347)

  • Tabs: drag a tab onto the middle of another tab to put them side by side. Hold over it for half a second to open it, then drop on the left, right, top or bottom half. The top and bottom edges still reorder.
  • Panes: drag a pane out of a split by its grip to make it its own tab, or drop it on another tab to join that split. A card follows the pointer, and a see-through tab shows where it will land.
  • Browser: websites with their own light/dark mode are never recolored, and the moon button is hidden there. Google Docs, Slides and similar pages are darkened again.
  • Browser: darkening light websites is off by default for new installs. Existing installs keep their setting (Settings > Browser).
  • Terminal: Ghostty engine updated to the latest version, with a speed fix and safer redraws. Settings shows the real engine version.
  • Terminal: persistent sessions now use zmx 1.0.1. A big burst of output no longer pins a CPU core.
  • After this update, open terminals reopen as new sessions in the same folder. A tab that still had Claude or Codex running has its old session ended and the agent resumed. Other old sessions keep running and are listed in Task Manager as "Orphaned terminal session (previous version)".
  • Quick AI: in a jj (Jujutsu) repository the Branch chip shows the bookmark name instead of "Detached HEAD".
  • A double-click on the empty part of the tab list creates one terminal, not several.
  • Updated Sparkle 2.10.1, PostHog 3.97.2 and Firebase 13.2.0.
